verses.original: שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וָשֵׁשׁ֙ לְמַלְכ֣וּת בִּשְׁנַ֨ת אָסָ֔א בַּעְשָׁ֤א מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עָלָ֞ה עַל־ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּ֖בֶן אֶת־ הָרָמָ֑ה לְבִלְתִּ֗י תֵּ֚ת יוֹצֵ֣א וָבָ֔א לְאָסָ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šə·lō·šîm wā·šêš lə·mal·ḵūṯ biš·naṯ ’ā·sā ba‘·šā me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘ā·lāh ‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh way·yi·ḇen ’eṯ- hā·rā·māh lə·ḇil·tî têṯ yō·w·ṣê wā·ḇā lə·’ā·sā me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: In the thirty-sixth . . . . . . year of Asa’s [reign] Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and fortified - Ramah vvv to prevent [anyone] from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah

verses.original: אָסָ֜א וַיֹּצֵ֨א כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֗ב מֵאֹֽצְר֛וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וּבֵ֣ית וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח לֵאמֹֽר׃ אֶל־ בֶּן־ הֲדַד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם הַיּוֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּדַרְמֶ֖שֶׂק
verses.transliteration: ’ā·sā way·yō·ṣê ke·sep̄ wə·zā·hāḇ mê·’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ bêṯ Yah·weh ham·me·leḵ ū·ḇêṯ way·yiš·laḥ lê·mōr ’el- ben- hă·ḏaḏ me·leḵ ’ă·rām hay·yō·wō·šêḇ bə·ḏar·me·śeq
verses.literal: So Asa withdrew the silver and gold from the treasuries of the house of the LORD and the royal palace and he sent it with this message to vvv Ben-hadad king of Aram who was ruling in Damascus

verses.original: בְּרִית֙ בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֔ךָ וּבֵ֥ין אָבִ֖י וּבֵ֣ין אָבִ֑יךָ הִנֵּ֨ה שָׁלַ֤חְתִּֽי לְךָ֙ כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֔ב לֵ֞ךְ הָפֵ֣ר בְּרִֽיתְךָ֗ אֶת־ בַּעְשָׁא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְיַעֲלֶ֖ה מֵעָלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rîṯ bê·nî ū·ḇê·ne·ḵā ū·ḇên ’ā·ḇî ū·ḇên ’ā·ḇî·ḵā hin·nêh šā·laḥ·tî lə·ḵā ke·sep̄ wə·zā·hāḇ lêḵ hā·p̄êr bə·rî·ṯə·ḵā ’eṯ- ba‘·šā me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl wə·ya·‘ă·leh mê·‘ā·lāy
verses.literal: [Let there be] a treaty between me and you [as there was] between . . . my father . . . and your father See I have sent you silver and gold Now go and break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel so that he will withdraw from me

verses.original: הֲדַ֜ד וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע בֶּן אֶל־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָסָ֗א וַ֠יִּשְׁלַח אֶת־ שָׂרֵ֨י הַחֲיָלִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר־ לוֹ֙ אֶל־ עָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּכּוּ֙ אֶת־ עִיּ֣וֹן וְאֶת־ דָּ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת אָבֵ֣ל מָ֑יִם וְאֵ֥ת כָּֽל־ מִסְכְּנ֖וֹת עָרֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ḏaḏ way·yiš·ma‘ bɛn ’el- ham·me·leḵ ’ā·sā way·yiš·laḥ ’eṯ- śā·rê ha·ḥă·yā·lîm ’ă·šer- lōw ’el- ‘ā·rê yiś·rā·’êl way·yak·kū ’eṯ- ‘î·yō·wn wə·’eṯ- dān wə·’êṯ ’ā·ḇêl mā·yim wə·’êṯ kāl- mis·kə·nō·wṯ ‘ā·rê nap̄·tā·lî
verses.literal: And Ben-hadad listened to King Asa and sent - the commanders of his armies - against the cities of Israel conquering - Ijon - Dan - vvv Abel-maim - and all the store cities of Naphtali

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ בַּעְשָׁ֔א כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ וַיֶּחְדַּ֕ל מִבְּנ֖וֹת אֶת־ הָרָמָ֑ה וַיַּשְׁבֵּ֖ת אֶת־ מְלַאכְתּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî ba‘·šā kiš·mō·a‘ way·yeḥ·dal mib·bə·nō·wṯ ’eṯ- hā·rā·māh way·yaš·bêṯ ’eṯ- mə·laḵ·tōw
verses.literal: - When Baasha learned of this he stopped fortifying - Ramah and abandoned - his work

verses.original: הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וְאָסָ֣א לָקַח֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּשְׂא֞וּ אֶת־ אַבְנֵ֤י הָֽרָמָה֙ וְאֶת־ עֵצֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּעְשָׁ֑א בָּנָ֖ה בָּהֶ֔ם וַיִּ֣בֶן אֶת־ גֶּ֖בַע וְאֶת־ הַמִּצְפָּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ham·me·leḵ wə·’ā·sā lā·qaḥ ’eṯ- kāl- yə·hū·ḏāh way·yiś·’ū ’eṯ- ’aḇ·nê hā·rā·māh wə·’eṯ- ‘ê·ṣe·hā ’ă·šer ba‘·šā bā·nāh bā·hem way·yi·ḇen ’eṯ- ge·ḇa‘ wə·’eṯ- ham·miṣ·pāh
verses.literal: Then King Asa brought - all [the men] of Judah and they carried away - the stones of Ramah - and the timbers - Baasha had used for building And with [these materials] he built up - Geba - and Mizpah

verses.original: הַהִ֗יא וּבָעֵ֣ת חֲנָ֣נִי הָרֹאֶ֔ה בָּ֚א אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ אָסָ֖א יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו בְּהִשָּׁ֨עֶנְךָ֜ עַל־ מֶ֤לֶךְ אֲרָם֙ וְלֹ֤א נִשְׁעַ֙נְתָּ֙ עַל־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ עַל־ כֵּ֗ן חֵ֥יל מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָ֖ם נִמְלַ֛ט מִיָּדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hî ū·ḇā·‘êṯ ḥă·nā·nî hā·rō·’eh bā ’el- me·leḵ ’ā·sā yə·hū·ḏāh way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw bə·hiš·šā·‘en·ḵā ‘al- me·leḵ ’ă·rām wə·lō niš·‘an·tā ‘al- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ‘al- kên ḥêl me·leḵ- ’ă·rām nim·laṭ mî·yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: At that time Hanani the seer came to King Asa of Judah and told him Because you have relied on the king of Aram and not - on the LORD your God . . . . . . the army of the king of Aram has escaped from your hand

verses.original: הָי֨וּ הֲלֹ֧א הַכּוּשִׁ֣ים וְהַלּוּבִ֗ים לָרֹ֛ב לְחַ֧יִל׀ לְהַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד לְרֶ֥כֶב וּלְפָרָשִׁ֖ים וּבְהִשָּֽׁעֶנְךָ֥ עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה נְתָנָ֥ם בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·yū hă·lō hak·kū·šîm wə·hal·lū·ḇîm lā·rōḇ lə·ḥa·yil lə·har·bêh mə·’ōḏ lə·re·ḵeḇ ū·lə·p̄ā·rā·šîm ū·ḇə·hiš·šā·‘en·ḵā ‘al- Yah·weh nə·ṯā·nām bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: Were not the Cushites and Libyans a vast army with many . . . chariots and horsemen Yet because you relied on the LORD He delivered them into your hand

verses.original: כִּ֣י עֵינָ֞יו יְהוָ֗ה מְשֹׁטְט֤וֹת בְּכָל־ הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ לְ֠הִתְחַזֵּק עִם־ לְבָבָ֥ם שָׁלֵ֛ם אֵלָ֖יו נִסְכַּ֣לְתָּ עַל־ זֹ֑את מֵעַ֔תָּה כִּ֣י יֵ֥שׁ עִמְּךָ֖ מִלְחָמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘ê·nāw Yah·weh mə·šō·ṭə·ṭō·wṯ bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ lə·hiṯ·ḥaz·zêq ‘im- lə·ḇā·ḇām šā·lêm ’ê·lāw nis·kal·tā ‘al- zōṯ mê·‘at·tāh kî yêš ‘im·mə·ḵā mil·ḥā·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: For the eyes of the LORD roam to and fro over all the earth to show Himself strong on behalf of [those] whose hearts are fully devoted to Him You have acted foolishly in this matter From now on therefore you will be at . . . war

verses.original: אָסָ֜א וַיִּכְעַ֨ס אֶל־ הָרֹאֶ֗ה כִּֽי־ בְזַ֥עַף עִמּ֖וֹ עַל־ זֹ֑את וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֙הוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית הַמַּהְפֶּ֔כֶת הַהִֽיא׃ בָּעֵ֥ת אָסָ֛א וַיְרַצֵּ֥ץ מִן־ הָעָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: ’ā·sā way·yiḵ·‘as ’el- hā·rō·’eh kî- ḇə·za·‘ap̄ ‘im·mōw ‘al- zōṯ way·yit·tə·nê·hū bêṯ ham·mah·pe·ḵeṯ ha·hî bā·‘êṯ ’ā·sā way·raṣ·ṣêṣ min- hā·‘ām
verses.literal: Asa was angry with the seer [and became] so enraged . . . over this matter that he put [the man] in prison . . . And at the same time Asa oppressed some of the people

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י אָסָ֔א הָרִאשׁוֹנִ֖ים וְהָאַחֲרוֹנִ֑ים הִנָּ֤ם כְּתוּבִים֙ עַל־ סֵ֣פֶר הַמְּלָכִ֔ים לִיהוּדָ֖ה וְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh diḇ·rê ’ā·sā hā·ri·šō·w·nîm wə·hā·’a·ḥă·rō·w·nîm hin·nām kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er ham·mə·lā·ḵîm lî·hū·ḏāh wə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now the acts of Asa from beginning to end are indeed written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel

verses.original: שְׁלוֹשִׁ֨ים וָתֵ֤שַׁע בִּשְׁנַת֩ לְמַלְכוּתוֹ֙ אָסָ֡א וַיֶּחֱלֶ֣א בְּרַגְלָ֔יו עַד־ חָלְי֑וֹ לְמַ֖עְלָה וְגַם־ בְּחָלְיוֹ֙ לֹא־ דָרַ֣שׁ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֖י בָּרֹפְאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: šə·lō·wō·šîm wā·ṯê·ša‘ biš·naṯ lə·mal·ḵū·ṯōw ’ā·sā way·ye·ḥĕ·le bə·raḡ·lāw ‘aḏ- ḥā·lə·yōw lə·ma‘·lāh wə·ḡam- bə·ḥā·lə·yōw lō- ḏā·raš ’eṯ- Yah·weh kî bā·rō·p̄ə·’îm
verses.literal: In the thirty-ninth . . . year of his reign Asa became diseased in his feet and his disease became increasingly severe Yet even in his illness he did not seek - the LORD but only the physicians

verses.original: אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וְאַחַ֖ת בִּשְׁנַ֛ת לְמָלְכֽוֹ׃ אָסָ֖א וַיָּ֕מָת וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֑יו
verses.literal: So in the forty-first . . . year of his reign Asa died and rested with his fathers

verses.original: וַיִּקְבְּרֻ֣הוּ בְקִבְרֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּֽרָה־ לוֹ֮ בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִיד֒ וַיַּשְׁכִּיבֻ֗הוּ בַּמִּשְׁכָּב֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִלֵּא֙ בְּשָׂמִ֣ים וּזְנִ֔ים מַעֲשֶׂ֑ה מְרֻקָּחִ֖ים בְּמִרְקַ֣חַת גְּדוֹלָ֥ה עַד־ לִמְאֹֽד׃פ וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ־ ל֥וֹ שְׂרֵפָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·bə·ru·hū ḇə·qiḇ·rō·ṯāw ’ă·šer kā·rāh- lōw bə·‘îr dā·wîḏ way·yaš·kî·ḇu·hū bam·miš·kāḇ ’ă·šer mil·lê bə·śā·mîm ū·zə·nîm ma·‘ă·śeh mə·ruq·qā·ḥîm bə·mir·qa·ḥaṯ gə·ḏō·w·lāh ‘aḏ- lim·’ōḏ way·yiś·rə·p̄ū- lōw śə·rê·p̄āh
verses.literal: And he was buried in the tomb that he had cut out for himself in the City of David They laid him on a bier that was full of spices and various blended perfumes . . . then they made a great . . . . . . fire in his honor
